question: g2_add_voucher
answer:
Done. `addToCart` in [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g2_add_voucher/source/codex/1/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) now takes `promoCode` as an optional last parameter; when given, it's sent as the `voucher` field in the POST/PUT cart body (the discount-code field on the backend's `BasketLineInput` cart-item request). When omitted/empty, the field isn't included, so all existing call sites behave exactly as before. The diff is just the signature plus a three-line conditional, with the file's CRLF line endings preserved.

- [constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g2_add_voucher/source/codex/1/src/util/constant.js) — confirmed the cart endpoint target
- Backend (read-only): `sm-shop/.../api/v1/shoppingCart/BasketEndpoint.java` (cart add/update endpoints) and `sm-shop-model/.../shoppingcart/BasketLineInput.java` (defines the `voucher` field)
